content.class.clerk.blurb: 守卫们请来一位书记，去读他们的旧档案，还要浇灭大厅里那座大壁炉——一百年来没人让它熄过。
content.class.clerk.kit.0.name: 书记的剑
content.class.clerk.kit.1.name: 书记的靴子
content.class.clerk.name: 守卫书记
content.fx.the-fire.oc.turn-the-sluice.4.narrate: 水轰隆隆灌下烟道。炉石上的火嘶的一声灭了，被水冲走，炉膛的砖背向黑暗里转开：壁炉后面，石阶脚下，守卫的密道开了。
content.fx.trig.the-burning-hearth.0.narrate: 大壁炉烧着，一烧就是一百年。能把烟道灌满水的闸门在石阶上面，守卫巷的尽头。
content.obj.the-fire.turn-the-sluice.hint: 沿壁炉旁的宽石阶上到守卫巷。闸门在巷子的另一头。
content.obj.the-fire.turn-the-sluice.title: 拉开巷子尽头的闸门
content.obj.the-records.enter-the-passage.hint: 从石阶下去。壁炉就在阶脚，火已经灭了。
content.obj.the-records.enter-the-passage.title: 穿过壁炉进入密道
content.quest.the-fire.goal: 来到守卫大厅，沿宽石阶上到守卫巷，拉开巷子尽头的闸门，让水灌满烟道，浇灭大壁炉。
content.quest.the-records.goal: 回到石阶下，穿过熄了火的壁炉，进入壁炉后面存放档案的守卫密道。
content.world.outro: 壁炉敞着，冷了下来，守卫大厅又安静了。
content.world.title: 壁炉之门

source.class.clerk.blurb: The wardens sent for a clerk to read their old records, and to put out the great hearth of their hall, which nobody has let go out in a hundred years.
source.class.clerk.kit.0.name: Clerk's sword
source.class.clerk.kit.1.name: Clerk's boots
source.class.clerk.name: Warden's Clerk
source.fx.the-fire.oc.turn-the-sluice.4.narrate: Water roars down the flue. The fire on the great hearth hisses out and washes away, and the back of the firebox swings into the dark: behind the hearth, at the stair's foot, the wardens' passage is open.
source.fx.trig.the-burning-hearth.0.narrate: The great hearth burns, as it has for a hundred years. The sluice that floods its flue is up the stair, at the end of Wardens' Lane.
source.obj.the-fire.turn-the-sluice.hint: Climb the broad stair beside the hearth to Wardens' Lane. The sluice is at the lane's far end.
source.obj.the-fire.turn-the-sluice.title: Pull the sluice at the lane's end
source.obj.the-records.enter-the-passage.hint: Go back down the stair. The hearth is at its foot, and its fire is out.
source.obj.the-records.enter-the-passage.title: Go through the hearth into the passage
source.quest.the-fire.goal: Arrive in the wardens' hall, climb the broad stair to Wardens' Lane, and turn the sluice at the lane's end that floods the flue and puts out the great hearth.
source.quest.the-records.goal: Go back down the stair and through the cold hearth into the wardens' passage behind the hearth, where the records are kept.
source.world.outro: The hearth stands open and cold, and the wardens' hall is quiet again.
source.world.title: The Hearth Door
